title: Imperative steps and shop scene
subject: Arabic
source: Seeded from arabic/y9 lesson 36 (Pupil PDF worksheet: imperative steps and shop scene)
intro: Lesson 36: The imperative in a shop: أَرِنِي، أَعْطِنِي. To understand how to use the imperative politely in a shop

model.title: Make the imperative of تَكْتُبُ (you write).

parts.label: Step 3
parts.text: Starts with sukun, so add a helping alif: اُكْتُبْ

questions.q: Ask politely: show me the red dress.
questions.model: Teacher: أَرِنِي (show me) + الفُسْتَانَ (object, fathah) + الأَحْمَرَ (agrees) + مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.

questions.q: Shop scene in the portal response box: write six polite requests a customer might make (with أَرِنِي، أَعْطِنِي and two imperatives you form yourself), and the seller's replies with تَفَضَّلْ. Include one request to a female seller.
questions.a: Six correct requests with objects in the accusative, polite softeners, one feminine form
questions.model: Teacher writes: أَعْطِنِي مِعْطَفًا بِمَقَاسٍ كَبِيرٍ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ. البَائِعُ: تَفَضَّلْ.

questions.q: Back to our ponder: how does a request sound polite?
questions.a: Add مِنْ فَضْلِكَ and a kind tone
